summary: Tested Bank Statement Analyzer feature - backend APIs and frontend UI. Backend: All 8 tests passed (analyze endpoint accepts PDF, rejects unsupported types/empty files, requires auth; history endpoint works). Frontend: Bank analyzer page loads correctly with upload area, bank badges, and file input. Fixed .env issue where EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was malformed.

issues: data-testid='bank-analyzer-link' is defined in React Native code but doesn't render to DOM (React Native Web limitation). The testID prop doesn't translate to data-testid HTML attribute. Navigation still works via clicking the text.

action_items: OPTIONAL: For better e2e testability, consider adding a web-specific ID via Platform.select in features.tsx for the bank-analyzer-link
critical_code_review_comments: Bank statement analyzer endpoint properly validates file types (.pdf, .asice only)
AI analysis uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from environment for GPT-4.1 integration
PDF text extraction uses PyMuPDF (fitz) library
History endpoint properly filters by admin_id and optional client_id
Frontend upload area correctly accepts .pdf and .asice files
seed_data_creation: Created test PDF using fpdf2 library with sample Swedbank statement content for API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank Statement Analyzer feature is fully working. Backend: POST /api/bank-statements/analyze (file upload), GET /api/bank-statements/history (past analyses). Frontend: /admin/bank-analyzer page with upload area. The AI analysis takes ~10 seconds with Emergent LLM. Note: data-testid attributes in React Native Web don't render to DOM - use text selectors for Playwright tests.

backend_analyze_endpoint.details: POST /api/bank-statements/analyze accepts PDF files, extracts text using PyMuPDF, analyzes with GPT-4.1, returns structured JSON with income/expense categories

backend_file_validation.details: Rejects unsupported file types (returns 400), rejects empty files (returns 400)

backend_auth_required.details: Both analyze and history endpoints require admin_token parameter

backend_history_endpoint.details: GET /api/bank-statements/history returns list of past analyses sorted by date descending

frontend_bank_analyzer_page.details: Page at /admin/bank-analyzer shows upload area, bank badges (Swedbank, SEB, LHV, Coop, Revolut, Wise, N26), file type hint (.pdf or .asice)

frontend_features_link.details: Features tab shows 'Pangaväljavõtte analüüs' link under ANALÜÜTIKA section, clicking navigates to /admin/bank-analyzer

frontend_file_input.details: Hidden file input accepts .pdf and .asice files, triggered by clicking upload area

bugs_fixed.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was on same line as RESEND_TEST_EMAIL without newline separator
bugs_fixed.fix: Added newline between RESEND_TEST_EMAIL and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
